paragraphs: The XF 2.2 Diesel uses the Ford Duratorq I4 — a 2.2-litre four-cylinder diesel unit fitted to the X250 generation from 2007 to 2015. This engine is part of Ford's Duratorq family, a widely-used diesel platform shared across several manufacturers of the era. The XF 2.2 Diesel was discontinued when the X260 generation replaced the X250 in 2015, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
